headline: Sensex Ends 107 Points Higher, Nifty Reclaims 25,000 Supported by PSU Banks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: PSU Bank index surged 3%, lifting the benchmark indices back into positive territory.
Early trade saw profit-taking and IT sector selling that briefly pushed markets into the red.
Sensex recovered over 100 points to settle above 81,000 while Nifty reclaimed 25,000.
State banks' dollar bids halted the Indian rupee's six-day winning streak.
whatHappening: Sensex ended 107 points higher and Nifty settled at 25,045.
Data Patterns shares jumped 9% during today's trading session.
Indian stock exchanges NSE and BSE will remain closed for a holiday on November 10.
RBI's $239 billion forward dollar position is projected to cap rupee gains despite foreign fund inflows.
summary: Indian benchmark indices closed higher on November 9, with Sensex up 107 points and Nifty settling above 25,000. Strong buying in PSU bank stocks helped the market recover from early profit-taking and IT sector drag. Stock markets will remain closed on November 10.
